properties.rationale: Standing acknowledgement, re-stated because the rollup's id moves whenever the capability set does: validation for this project is the trials programme — reflow2 used on real designs, which this week meant an adopt pass over dynograph-foundation and a live two-session seam exercise that found four defects nobody had reviewed their way to. It is not a validation-kind Verification per capability. Recording 61 near-identical validation nodes would make the number go green without anyone having checked anything, which is the dishonesty `dec:passing-is-verified` exists to prevent.
